scripts.dev:legacy: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:e2e:insurance: PLAYWRIGHT_MOCK_AUTH=1 PLAYWRIGHT_MOCK_DATA=1 playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts insurance-estimate-write-smoke.spec.ts insurance-portal-accessibility.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:mips: npm run test:mips:backend && npm run test:mips:frontend
scripts.test:mips:release: npm run test:release-gate && npm run test:backup
scripts.test:mips:browser:chromium: CI=1 PLAYWRIGHT_MOCK_AUTH=1 PLAYWRIGHT_MOCK_DATA=1 playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts mips-readiness-release.spec.ts --project=chromium
scripts.test:mips:browser: CI=1 PLAYWRIGHT_MOCK_AUTH=1 PLAYWRIGHT_MOCK_DATA=1 playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts mips-readiness-release.spec.ts --project=chromium --project=firefox --project=webkit --project='Mobile Chrome' --project='Mobile Safari'
scripts.test:mips:qualification: npm run test:mips && npm run test:mips:release && npm run test:mips:pilot && npm run test:mips:browser
scripts.test:release-gate: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix backend && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd .. && npm run test:frontend:release && npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run test:e2e:smoke
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:ci: npm run test && npm run test:e2e:all
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
